nodes.label: Flask.wsgi_app
nodes.desc: The real WSGI callable: builds a context, dispatches, and always pops it in a finally block.

nodes.label: Flask.request_context
nodes.desc: Wraps the WSGI environ into an AppContext via AppContext.from_environ.

nodes.label: AppContext.from_environ
nodes.desc: Since 3.2 a single merged context holds app, request, session, and g.

nodes.label: AppContext.push
nodes.desc: Sets the _cv_app contextvar, opens the session, then matches the URL.

nodes.label: url_map (Werkzeug Map)
nodes.desc: Every registered Rule lives here; adapters bind it to the incoming request.

nodes.label: Blueprint.register
nodes.desc: At setup, replays deferred route callbacks and merges blueprint scopes into the app.

nodes.label: Flask.full_dispatch_request
nodes.desc: Runs preprocess, dispatch, and error handling around the view call.

nodes.label: Flask.preprocess_request
nodes.desc: Runs url_value_preprocessors then before_request_funcs in blueprint scope order.

nodes.label: Flask.dispatch_request
nodes.desc: Reads req.url_rule set during push and calls view_functions[rule.endpoint].

nodes.label: Flask.finalize_request
nodes.desc: make_response converts the return value, then process_response runs after-request hooks.

nodes.label: AppContext.pop
nodes.desc: Runs teardown_request then teardown_appcontext, resets the contextvar, sends appcontext_popped.

edges.label: rv from view or error handler
